\begin{proof}
Let $a,b\in G$ be arbitrary. We have
\[
ba=a^{-1}(ab)a,
\]
so $ba$ is conjugate to $ab$. The order of an element is invariant under conjugation: for every positive integer $n$,
\[
\bigl(a^{-1}(ab)a\bigr)^n=a^{-1}(ab)^n a.
\]
Consequently, $(ab)^n=e$ if and only if $(ba)^n=e$. Their least positive such exponents are therefore equal, and hence
\[
|ab|=|ba|.
\]
\end{proof}

\[
(ab)^n=\bigl(a(ba)a^{-1}\bigr)^n=a(ba)^n a^{-1}=e,
